title: Reboot server
desc: Restart this server. A reboot is never automatic: you start it, and Tugra checks afterwards that everything that was running came back.
viewOnly: You can see the reboot status. Rebooting needs the server operator role.

dialog.scheduleRange: Between 1 minute and 7 days from now.
dialog.impact: {containers} containers and {domains} domains will be briefly unavailable.
dialog.impactFailed: Could not read what is running. The reboot can still go ahead.
dialog.impactAfter: Tugra checks afterwards that every container with a restart policy runs again and every domain answers.
dialog.hub: This server also runs the Tugra hub itself. The panel will go away for 1 to 3 minutes and come back on its own.
dialog.agentOffline: The server's agent is offline right now, so a reboot cannot be started.
dialog.typeToConfirm: Type the server name {name} to confirm

scheduleError.past: Pick a time at least a minute from now.
scheduleError.tooFar: Pick a time within the next 7 days.

live.heading: Reboot in progress

hint.scheduled: Nothing happens until then. You can cancel until it starts.
hint.rebooting: The server is going down. This takes a few minutes.
hint.waiting: The server is down or starting up. Waiting for the agent to reconnect.
hint.verifying: The agent is back. Checking that every container and domain came back.

live.unreachable: The panel can't reach the hub right now. That is expected while the server that hosts it reboots; this page keeps trying.

report.title: Last reboot

result.degraded: Some things did not come back

report.summary: {containersOk} of {containersTotal} containers running, {domainsOk} of {domainsTotal} domains answering
report.rebootRequiredStill: The server still asks for a reboot.
report.rebootRequiredUnknown: Whether the server still asks for a reboot could not be read.
report.domainsSkipped: Domains were not checked: this server's proxy has no host port to probe.
report.probeUnavailable: Domains could not be checked: the probe could not run on the server.

reason.snapshot_failed: Tugra could not read what was running, so nothing was rebooted.
reason.start_failed: The reboot could not be armed on the server.
reason.interrupted: The hub was interrupted before the reboot started.
reason.agent_never_returned: The server's agent did not come back in time.
reason.docker_inactive: Docker did not come back after the reboot.
reason.state_unreadable: The server could not be read after the reboot.
reason.missed: The scheduled time passed while the hub could not start the reboot, so it was not run.
reason.unauthorized: The person who scheduled the reboot can no longer run server operations on this team.
